scientific_question: Does failure-group-conditioned credit assignment exhibit a repeated, time-leading, DRTP-specific signature that explains lower-tail training failures across independent seeds?

experiments.contribution: Zero of five clean seeds reproduced the complete frozen early-failure signature.

experiments.intervention: L1 trust region on q update
experiments.contribution: Sampler step limiting preserved the upper tail but did not protect the worst seed.

experiments.intervention: L1 trust region plus 20% uniform anchor
experiments.contribution: Removed the frozen catastrophic labels in this cohort but failed the preregistered reliability gate.

experiments.intervention: frozen trust region plus uniform anchor
experiments.contribution: Independent five-seed replication reversed the apparent S2 protection and increased dispersion.

experiments.intervention: post-step actor rollback on KL violation
experiments.contribution: Lower tail improved, but the high-yield seed lost fault-condition performance; the intervention preceded q divergence.
A gentler actor-update guard did not rescue any seed and worsened safety.

experiments.intervention: training-only paired probe for sampler evidence
experiments.contribution: Strong pilot rescue did not establish upper-tail retention because the cohort lacked a strong original upper tail.
Independent validation reversed the pilot: two catastrophic candidates, worse dispersion, and upper-tail loss.
The selector predicted absolute outcome but did not reliably preserve paired advantage over UTR.

candidate_hypotheses.name: failure_group_conditioned_credit_assignment
candidate_hypotheses.support: Fault-conditional upper-tail loss can occur without nominal collapse; global sampler and PPO guards have not generalized.
candidate_hypotheses.missing: Per-group value residuals, advantages, and actor/critic gradient conflict before divergence.

candidate_hypotheses.name: generic_mappo_basin_sensitivity
candidate_hypotheses.support: Divergence timing and failure modes are heterogeneous, and no repeated DRTP-specific precursor has survived confirmation.
candidate_hypotheses.missing: A same-seed UTR control with identical group-conditioned telemetry.

candidate_hypotheses.name: sampler_distribution_instability
candidate_hypotheses.support: TR, anchor, paired probe, and population selection each failed independent generalization.
candidate_hypotheses.missing: None sufficient to justify another sampler-only patch.

candidate_hypotheses.name: global_actor_kl_instability
candidate_hypotheses.support: KLR rescued the lower tail but damaged fault-conditioned upper-tail performance; KLB failed all pilot seeds.
candidate_hypotheses.missing: Global KL alone cannot localize group-conditioned credit conflict.

observational_cohort.seed_status: provisionally clean by repository filename and source-text audit; archive-content audit required before freeze
observational_cohort.stage_05m_decision: descriptive checkpoint only; no performance stop
observational_cohort.reason_for_1m_ceiling: Existing R1 failures first appeared between 0.75M and 1M, so 0.5M cannot falsify the candidate mechanism.
mechanism_go: same-direction pattern in at least two of five adverse DRTP seeds
matched UTR lacks an equally strong pattern
at least two middle-layer indicators support the credit-assignment layer
conclusion is robust to preregistered neighboring thresholds
observational_cohort.mechanism_no_go: If the complete signature is absent by 1M, close B-line algorithm development; do not invent another patch.
